source_text: Vis frater? Vadam. Sequuntur. Isaac mediatur in agro; ducit eam in tabernaculum Sarae. Haec Homiliae IX finis. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Will-you go girl? I-will-go. They-follow. Isaac meditates in field; leads her into tent of-Sarah. These of-Homily IX end. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Will you go? I will go >> Bible:Genesis 24:58]]. They follow. [[Isaac meditates in the field >> Bible:Genesis 24:63]] and brings her into Sarah’s tent. This is Homily IX’s end. Amen.
